item.description: Pakistan U-19 team mentor Sarfaraz Ahmed spoke out after a video featuring his voice went viral on the internet, claiming that the Indian U19 side showed disrespect during the Asia Cup final in Dubai on Sunday (December 21). item.title: “I came into the team under him only,” Amit Mishra rejects claims of not having MS Dhoni’s full backing
item.description: Former India spinner Amit Mishra recently opened up on his relationship with the legendary skipper MS Dhoni during his playing days. Mishra represented India in 22 Tests, 36 ODIs, and 10 T20Is from 2003 to 2017, claiming 76, 64 and 16 wickets respectively. The leg-spinner had to fight for a spot in the national team due to the presence of Anil Kumble and Harbhajan Singh. item.title: Usman Khawaja's wife, daughters face nasty comments on social media after Bondi Beach terror attack
item.description: A Hanukkah celebration at Sydney's Bondi Beach was shattered by a massacre on December 14, 2025. Two gunmen, Sajeed Akram and his son Naveed, opened fire and left 15 people dead Following the attack, the family of Australian cricketer Usman Khawaja, who belongs to the Muslim community, has been targeted with some hostile comments on social media. While the southpaw is yet to react, his wife Rachel Khawaja shared a screenshot of the unpleasant remarks that targeted the couple's daughters as well.

item.title: BCCI announces substantial pay hike for domestic women cricketers, match officials
item.description: In a historic move, the BCCI has more than doubled the match fees of women cricketers and officials in domestic cricket. It comes nearly a couple of months after India's maiden Women’s ODI World Cup triumph, with the board aiming to create a more equitable pay structure across the circuit. The significant pay hike was approved by the Board's Apex Council.
